I am 64 and farming alone on my 4.1 mu. My son is not here, so I do most of the work myself and pay the machinery man for ploughing and harvesting. Every yuan counts because I only have this small land.

For wheat in winter, I will plant Jimai variety like last year — the seed dealer in town sells it and my neighbors got good yield from it. I buy two bags of compound fertilizer 15-15-15, that is about 100 jin (50 kg) per bag, and spread before sowing. Then at green-up in spring I topdress with urea, about half a bag (25 kg) for my plot. I water the wheat 3 times — before winter, at jointing, and at grain filling. The well is close so water is not too expensive but electricity still costs. I spray herbicide once in spring and one pesticide for aphids at heading time.

For summer maize, I plant Zhengdan or a similar hybrid, direct seed after wheat harvest with the seeder man. I put one bag of compound fertilizer at planting and topdress urea about 30 kg at the big trumpet stage. Maize in our area only needs 1-2 waterings if rain is poor. One spray for corn borer, sometimes two if I see many worms.

I use rotary tillage because the machinery man has that tractor and it is cheaper than plough. I don't change much from last year — last year yield was okay, wheat maybe 450 kg/mu, maize close to 550 kg/mu. At my age I don't try new things unless I see the neighbor succeed first.
